name: State Space Tension Fingerprinting
description: Replaced the original 2-coloring bipartite condition with a custom configuration state space where the sum of absolute differences across edges (tension) is computed. The target number of 'relaxed' states (12) uniquely fingerprints a triangle (3 edges), forcing models to either perform mathematical deduction or fall into an O(N^3) simulation trap that guarantees a Time Limit Exceeded failure.
